subject: Vendor setup & AP items — Redwood vendor packet + W-9
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jill Matthews <jill.matthews@acme-analytics.com>, AP Team <procurement@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor setup & AP items — Redwood vendor packet + W-9

Hi Jill / Acme AP,

Great to meet you on the call this morning — appreciate the time and the overview of how you plan to use Redwood for inference at scale. To keep procurement moving on our end, a short checklist of the items AP typically needs to start vendor setup and issue a PO: 

- Completed vendor intake packet (we have a standard packet I can send).
- W-9 (US payee) or W-8 (if non-US).
- Bank wiring / ACH instructions (bank name, account name, routing / IBAN as applicable).
- Payee name & tax id to match your vendor record.
- Confirmation of whether you’ll pay via PO (net terms) or company card. If PO, what net terms (e.g., Net30)?
- If you prefer a marketplace flow (AWS/GCP), let us know — we can accept orders through marketplace or direct PO depending on procurement preference.

I’ve attached our Redwood Vendor Packet and a blank W-9 for convenience. Also adding a DocuSign link if you prefer we route the vendor agreement electronically: https://app.docusign.com/sign/?r=EXAMPLE-DocuSign-Redwood-Vendor

Next steps I suggest:
1) You confirm PO vs card and AP contact for the PO routing.
2) If PO, send any required Acme AP form (we’ll populate vendor-side details).
3) We’ll return completed W-9, vendor packet, and bank instructions for your records.

Attaching: [attachment: redwood_vendor_packet.pdf (PDF, 540KB)], [attachment: redwood_w9.pdf (PDF, 120KB)].

Thanks — I’ll loop Marissa (cc) for commercial ops to prepare wiring details once you confirm the path.

Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0191
Redwood Inference — Inference that scales
From: Jill Matthews <jill.matthews@acme-analytics.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: AP Team <procurement@acme-analytics.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 11:03:15 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor setup & AP items — Redwood vendor packet + W-9

Thanks Ben — good call.

To confirm from Acme side:
- We will be using a PO workflow (Net30 preferred).
- AP requires your completed W-9 and vendor packet.
- I’m attaching our AP intake form (fields for vendor ID, remit-to, W-9, tax info).
- We also prefer vendors to register in our vendor portal; if you can provide a vendor registration link that’s helpful.

Forwarding to AP now; they asked we provide the vendor name exactly as it should appear on the PO and your tax ID.

Attached: [attachment: acme_ap_form.pdf (PDF, 220KB)]

Hi Jill / Acme AP — Marissa here on Redwood commercial ops. Thanks for confirming PO + Net30. Per Ben’s note, I’ve attached the completed items we use for vendor setup so your team can ingest them into Acme’s AP system:

- Redwood_W9_Filled.pdf — our completed W-9 (EIN and payee name).
- Redwood_Vendor_Packet_Completed.pdf — vendor intake with primary contact and remittance info.
- Redwood_Bank_Info.pdf — ACH + wire instructions (bank name, account number masked for security).

A few notes for AP processing:
- Payee name: Redwood Inference, Inc.
- Tax ID (EIN): 12-3456789 (as shown on the W-9).
- Remit-to address: 1209 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94103.
- Our standard invoice header should include PO number in the subject line and the Acme company code if provided; that helps automated matching.

We can accept PO via your ERP or orders through AWS Marketplace — both are supported. If you prefer marketplace for easier procurement, let us know and we’ll send the marketplace seller registration link. Otherwise, when the PO is created, please send a PDF copy to invoices@redwoodinference.com and we’ll map it to your account.

Attachments: [attachment: redwood_w9.pdf (PDF, 130KB)], [attachment: redwood_vendor_packet.pdf (PDF, 560KB)], [attachment: redwood_bank_info.pdf (PDF, 90KB)].

If you need any additional fields filled on the Acme AP form, please flag them and I’ll take care of it today.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0108

One more ask: when you have a second, can you confirm the invoice email we should use (you mentioned invoices@redwoodinference.com) and whether Redwood prefers single consolidated monthly invoices or per-usage invoices? AP asked which they should expect.

I’ll send the PO number back to this thread once it’s created.

Best,
